We need to provide the name of the protein. For each protein we need to call the function. The function signature expects:

{
  protein_name: string,
  model_3d?: boolean // default true
}

So we should call it three times: one for human HbA1c, one for normal hemoglobin (maybe human?), and one for rat hemoglobin. But the user says "normal blood hemoglobin" - likely refers to normal human hemoglobin? Or maybe they want the normal form of hemoglobin (not glycated). So we might interpret as human hemoglobin (non-glycated). And then rat hemoglobin.

Thus we will call the function thrice. The function returns any type; presumably JSON containing sequence and 3D model data. We'll output the results.
